test_title: PYST 57: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A type of substance or material that burns very quickly
solution:
The correct answer is **'inflammable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inflammable **means a substance that can easily be set on fire or burnt. 

 
 
• Example- Alcohol is an **inflammable** substance.
 
 
 
• So clearly this word is the most appropriate choice for the given group of words.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incredible **means something that is difficult to believe or unbelievable.

 
 
• Example- The crowd at Ratha Yatra was **incredible**.
 
 
 
• **Invisible** means something that is not seen.
 
 
• Example- 'Mr.India' movie is about an **invisible** man.
 
 
 
• **Indelible** means making marks that cannot be removed.
 
 
• Example- Her memories have an **indelible **effect on me.
